name: Laser eye surgery (LASIK / SMILE / PRK)
summary: How expats evaluate refractive surgery centres in Singapore for LASIK, SMILE, and PRK — suitability checks, military/occupation limits, and why optical shops are not the same as surgical counselling.
body:
Refractive surgery is a common expat “while I’m here” procedure: stable myopia, contact-lens fatigue in humidity, and competitive package marketing. Optical retailers and ophthalmology centres both advertise laser — only surgical pathways with proper suitability workups belong in this decision.

## Procedure map
- **LASIK** — flap + laser reshape; fast visual recovery for many candidates
- **SMILE** — small-incision lenticule extraction; different dry-eye and activity profiles
- **PRK / surface ablation** — no flap; slower recovery, useful for thinner corneas or certain occupations
- **ICL / lens options** — when cornea is unsuitable

Suitability needs topography, thickness, tear assessment, and realistic expectation setting — not only a power check at a mall optician.

## Occupational caveats
Some employers, aviation, diving, and uniformed roles have waiting periods or restrictions after laser. Confirm with your employer medical team before booking. Dry-eye risk is real in Singapore air-con; discuss occupation and screen time honestly.

## Cost and marketing
Quoted “both eyes” packages often exclude enhancements, medications, or follow-ups beyond a window. Ask about retreat rates, surgeon identity (not only brand), and after-hours complication pathways. Insurance almost never covers elective refractive surgery.

## How to choose
Prefer centres where an ophthalmologist examines you, explains why you are (or are not) a candidate, and does not pressure same-day surgery after a free screening. Bring prior prescriptions and soft-lens holiday duration requirements. If you only need progressive glasses or myopia control for kids, stay with optical/ophthalmology pathways — do not laser-shop those problems.

## Practical tip
Stop contact lenses for the full advised period before topography. Flying home immediately after surgery complicates follow-up — plan local review visits before long-haul travel.
whenToEngage: Mall laser package before ophthalmologist suitability workup
Occupation or diving rules may restrict post-laser timing
Dry-eye risk in air-con needs frank counselling
